requirement: An authenticated member can view only their own trip details. The API returns 404 for a trip owned by another member and records the denied access attempt.

evidence.content: An authenticated member can view only their own trip details. Requests for another member's trip return 404 and record the denied access attempt.
GET /trips/{tripId} returns 200 for an owned trip, 404 when the trip is unavailable to the caller, and 401 when authentication is absent.
Trip ownership is enforced by the authorization service before trip details are loaded.

requirement: Submit an eligibility request to the provider gateway and show the returned eligibility status.

evidence.content: Submit an eligibility request to the provider gateway and show the returned eligibility status.
POST /eligibility returns active or inactive eligibility. No timeout response or retry behavior is specified.

allowedMissingEvidence: Provider gateway timeout behavior is not documented.

requirement: Allow guest users to download reports, although the security ADR requires authentication for every report endpoint.

evidence.content: Guest users can download reports without signing in.
All report endpoints require an authenticated principal and an authorization check.

allowedContradictions: The story permits guest access, but the security ADR requires authentication.
